original_ai_output.title_zh: 马拉卡勒弱势居民获发30份土地登记文件
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹上尼罗州马拉卡勒一个民间社会联盟向在冲突和流离失所中丢失土地登记文件的弱势居民移交了30份土地登记文件，旨在加强产权、减少土地纠纷。该活动由自然资源民间社会联盟与挪威人民援助组织及州政府合作开展，面向寡妇、孤儿、老人、境内流离失所者、返乡者和残疾人。参与者呼吁扩大援助范围并降低登记费用。

key_facts.fact: 民间社会联盟向马拉卡勒弱势居民移交30份土地登记文件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A civil society coalition has handed over 30 land registration documents to vulnerable residents who lost their papers during conflict and displacement in Upper Nile State

key_facts.fact: 活动由自然资源民间社会联盟与挪威人民援助组织及州政府合作开展
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Coalition of Civil Society on Natural Resources (CSCNR), in collaboration with Norwegian People’s Aid (NPA) and state authorities, launched an awareness campaign in Malakal

key_facts.fact: 援助对象包括寡妇、孤儿、老人、境内流离失所者、返乡者和残疾人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The programme targeted widows, orphans, older people, internally displaced people, returnees and people with disabilities

key_facts.fact: 上尼罗州自2013年以来受冲突影响
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Upper Nile State, like neighbouring Unity State, has been affected by conflict since 2013
The campaign included an awareness session attended by 44 people

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
